papers.title: MoE-Inference: Sparse Expert Routing for Low-Latency Serving
papers.abstract: Serving mixture-of-experts models is bottlenecked by expert load imbalance. We present a routing-aware scheduler that co-locates hot experts and prefetches weights across NVLink domains, reducing p99 latency by 38% on an 8-GPU node while keeping throughput within 4% of the dense baseline.

papers.title: KV-Cache Compression via Learned Token Eviction
papers.abstract: We learn a lightweight scorer to evict KV cache entries at decode time. Evaluated on long-context benchmarks, the method keeps 96% of full-cache accuracy at a 3.2x compression ratio and improves decode tokens/s by 1.9x.

papers.title: HBM4 Interconnect Characterization for Scale-Up Clusters
papers.abstract: We measure HBM4 signal integrity across a 72-GPU scale-up domain and report bandwidth degradation of 11% under sustained all-reduce traffic, with mitigation via adaptive refresh scheduling.

news.title: 美团大规模推理集群的调度实践
news.abstract: 介绍了异构 GPU 集群下基于拓扑感知的调度方案，将跨机通信开销降低 23%。
